name: CommIT Con
blurb: A free, student-run pop-culture convention at the IT University of Copenhagen, open to students and non-students alike.
notes: The homepage carries no date text at all, and its own Schedule page (con/schedule) says 'Schedule Coming Soon! We are currently finalizing the schedule for CommIT Con', with no date given either. That page's JSON-LD lists a SocialEvent on 2026-03-28, but per the research procedure JSON-LD is often stale and that date has already passed relative to this 2026-10-05 research window, so it is recorded as 'last' rather than as a confirmed upcoming edition. No next date is announced yet; recheck closer to the next CommIT Con. No guest roster was found (small student con; 'Coming Soon' schedule suggests the program, and likely any guest list, is not yet public), so guests were not captured. Organizer name (presumably a student society at ITU) was not found on the page.
